evidence.statement: The fictional workspace may present answers, selections and proposals but never commits scheduling state.
Every focused view remains a temporary projection of one fictional authoritative schedule.
Scope, omissions, freshness and the route back remain visible in every focused view.
Answer, selection, proposal, notice, block and receipt require distinct plain-language states.
Landscape and portrait tablet layouts are first-class workspaces, not compressed desktop screens.
A committed change uses restrained, nonmodal attention and fresh reconciliation.
Sensitive display content can be masked immediately and resumption requires refreshed state.
An ordinary schedule view remains an immediate and reversible escape.
